DIAGNOSIS READY: Mallet Finger (Extensor Tendon Rupture)

The clinical picture of an acute injury followed by a finger that is extended at rest, painful upon flexion, and X-ray evidence of soft tissue swelling at the DIP joint is highly specific for a mallet finger. We have ruled out fracture, dislocation, and infection based on your history and imaging.

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Rupture of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at its point of insertion
